name: The Dunemaul Compound
summary: In the desert south of Gadgetzan, a growing ogre force has Andi Lynn afraid. She wants the compound destroyed before the ogres gather more strength.

sections.title: Ogres in the Desert
sections.body: A large band of nomadic ogres has reached Tanaris. South of Gadgetzan, they have claimed a broad stretch of desert and made their compound. Smaller bands roam the desert, and some have entered the old troll ruins. Andi Lynn fears what may happen if the ogres grow stronger.

sections.title: Cutting Off the Head
sections.body: Andi Lynn wants ten Dunemaul Brutes and ten Dunemaul Enforcers cut down. Gor'marok the Ravager leads the band. Andi Lynn believes the ogres will begin to crumble once he no longer commands them.

faq.q: Who asks for the Dunemaul Compound to be destroyed?
faq.answer: Andi Lynn, in Gadgetzan, calls for the Dunemaul Compound to be destroyed.
The ogres have claimed a large stretch of desert south of Gadgetzan.
Gor'marok the Ravager leads the Dunemaul ogres. Andi Lynn believes they will begin to fall once he no longer commands them.

faq.q: Why does Andi Lynn see the ogres as a danger?
faq.answer: Andi Lynn fears the ogres will gather strength. A large band holds a compound south of Gadgetzan, while smaller bands roam the desert, and some have entered the old troll ruins.
